messages:
Iris H: hitting a weird onboarding hang in the sampleapp when using the Go SDK (v0.9.4). Direct curl to the REST API succeeds.
Iris H: repro: click Import creds -> modal shows "verifying" and never resolves. Network shows repeated 401s coming from the browser extension that proxies the Go SDK requests.
Dan F: can you paste the outgoing headers or a small HAR?
Iris H: minimal Go call: `client.AuthVerify(ctx, opts)` and captured headers show Authorization + User-Agent only; our tracing header X-Trace-Client and X-Redwood-Client are missing.
Iris H: curl that works: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/verify -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_x' -H 'X-Trace-Client: sampleapp/go-0.2' -d '{"key":"sk_x"}'`
Priya S: the server routes some legacy auth logic when X-Trace-Client is present; if header missing it hits a stricter token-checker and returns 401. Why is the Go SDK dropping unknown headers?
Marco L: discovered two parity issues: 1) Go SDK HTTP client drops unknown headers by default (we set a whitelist) so customers' tracing headers are lost; 2) default retry policy in the SDK includes 401 which causes infinite retries from the client side and the UX spinner never surfaces the auth error.
Dan F: ouch. Retry on 401 is definitely wrong. Retries should only be for network failures + 502/503/504 (and 429 optionally for idempotent ops). We'll need a quick patch.
Priya S: another subtle one: REST accepts `model_ref` and `model_id` interchangeably for some admin endpoints. The Go SDK only accepts `model` and will send it as-is which triggers 400s for git-based onboarding flows. We should accept aliases model/model_ref/model_id and normalize in the SDK. Also REST supports `idempotency_key` on create requests; Go SDK doesn't expose it which caused duplicate uploads when users retried.
Iris H: I attached a HAR and a small repro gist to the internal issue: https://internal-redwood/repro/2001234567.har
ci-bot: Created ticket SDK-GO-2711: "go-sdk parity: header passthrough, retry-on-401, model_ref alias, idempotency_key"
Marco L: plan: (A) quick patch to remove 401/403 from default retries and add a config flag for aggressive retry behavior; (B) stop stripping unknown headers - forward them end-to-end; (C) add parameter aliasing for model/model_ref/model_id and prefer explicit model_id if present; (D) expose optional idempotency_key on createModel/createVersion.
Dan F: I'll open patch for A+B, tiny change should land in ~2h. Marco, can you handle C+D? Also please add unit tests for aliasing and a sampleapp smoke test that hits the onboarding path with an invalid key and asserts we surface 401 immediately (no retries) and that outgoing requests include X-Trace-Client.
Marco L: yep will add smoke test in sampleapp e2e and a Go SDK integration test. PR will reference SDK-GO-2711.
Iris H: thanks all. Once the patch is staged I can validate with the repro. This blocked a small pilot customer so marking P0. :thumbsup:
